name: deploy-ephemeral-web-preview
job: Publish a short-lived public web URL for demos or agent proof, with claim and expiry honesty.

inScope: Classifying the artifact and picking the lowest-auth provider
Deploying via the lowest-friction working path
Verifying the live URL with probes and real browser loads when UI matters
Recording expiry, claim path, and preview-versus-production separation
outOfScope: Production traffic, customer data, or long-lived domains

inputs: Artifact (static files, worker, or app) and proof window
Verification bar for the claimed demo
outputs: Public URL with probe recorded (status and headers)
Provider and free class stated with expiry and claim path
Residuals: custom domain, secrets, durable data, auth

tools: deploy CLI for the selected provider
permissions: provider claim token handling per trust level

failureSemantics: No URL is claimed live without a probe; a 200 on / alone does not prove an SPA works client-side; claim tokens are treated as ownership bearers and never pasted into untrusted channels; expiry is always stated.

outcome.observable: A public URL that responds to verification probes with recorded expiry and claim path, and residuals documented so the user knows the preview is not durable production.
